title: Triage Wizard: ephemeral telemetry aggregator + guided playbook preview
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR introduces a 'Triage Wizard' micro-workflow for on-call responders that assembles a compact, ephemeral telemetry snapshot and renders a guided playbook preview pre-populated with suggested remedial steps. Motivation: reduce cognitive overhead during incident triage by surfacing only the most relevant metrics, traces, and recent errors for the alert context, and to let responders preview playbook steps with example commands before executing. The core pieces: 1) telemetry-aggregator service: background job that collects top-5 signals (latency p50/p95, error trends, recent traces, host counts, queue depth) and outputs a compressed JSON blob; 2) triage-preview UI: client component that renders the snapshot alongside a stepwise playbook with inline 'try this' commands; 3) CLI hook: ability to fetch ephemeral snapshot and run a local dry-run of suggested remediation; 4) safety and privacy filters: removes PII, strips long stack traces, and enforces sampling rates. Checklist: - [x] backend aggregator and schema - [x] UI preview component with mock data - [x] CLI fetcher and dry-run runner - [x] unit and e2e tests - [x] docs for oncall usage - [x] feature flag gating in prod. This description covers design notes, compatibility considerations, and rollout plan: start gated under feature flag 'triage_wizard_v1', enable for SRE alpha team, collect UX metrics and error rates for 2 weeks, then broader rollout. Related linear items and usage playbook included in linked tickets.
commits: feat(aggregator): add ephemeral telemetry aggregator and compression
feat(ui): triage preview component with de-duped signal list
feat(cli): add triage-fetch and dry-run runner
test: add e2e test for triage flow and sampling filter
chore: add feature flag and initial docs
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Nice approach; can you clarify why we compress JSON server-side vs client-side? Author: Compressing server-side reduces payload size for oncall mobile usage and centralizes sampling logic. We use gzip + base64 for the first pass. Diego: ok, please add a comment in aggregator/main.py explaining that tradeoff.
Priya Natarajan: UX looks good, but we should display uncertainty on inferred root causes. Author: Added a 'confidence' field in schema and reflected it in the preview tooltip.
Samir Patel: Add a toggle to opt-out from including sample traces due to size. Author: Added feature flag and per-team opt-out in config/feature_flags.yaml. Samir: Approved after CI green.
release_notes: Adds 'Triage Wizard' feature that assembles ephemeral telemetry snapshots and provides a guided playbook preview for faster oncall triage. Feature behind flag 'triage_wizard_v1'.
summary: Provides lightweight oncall tooling to reduce triage time by delivering concise telemetry snapshots and playable remediation suggestions.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag 'triage_wizard_v1' for SRE-alpha only. Monitor aggregator job latency and payload size metric 'triage_aggregator_payload_bytes'. Rollback by disabling feature flag or reverting config entry in feature_flags.yaml.
